notes: FIX STORY ARCHITECTURE THAT BAI VI MODEL REASONING AN HET TOKEN (tren nen v23.6.35). Trieu chung: 'Story architecture failed after 3 attempts: API response did not contain usable choices/message/content' voi finish_reason='length', content chi la doan suy nghi ('We need to produce JSON with story architecture...'). Nguyen nhan: model reasoning viet phan suy nghi truoc, an het max_tokens=4000 truoc khi kip ra JSON; tool cu thu lai Y NGUYEN max_tokens cu nen lap lai y het va that bai ca 3 lan. Da sua trong _writer_json_call: (1) doc finish_reason qua chat_finish_reason(); (2) khi bi cat thi TU DONG TANG GAP DOI max_tokens (4000 -> 8000 -> 16000) thay vi thu lai y nguyen; (3) phat hien content khong co JSON thi bao loi ro rang; (4) tu lan thu lai them chi thi 'Output ONLY the raw JSON object... Start your reply with { and end with }'; (5) tran tren cung qua key moi writer_max_tokens_cap (mac dinh 16000), de trong DEFAULT_CONFIG chu KHONG ghim trong FIXED_PRODUCTION_SETTINGS. Da test: mo phong dung loi trong anh -> cuu duoc bai o lan 3 voi max_tokens=16000; dung tran khong tang vo han; truong hop binh thuong (finish_reason=stop) van goi 1 lan, giu nguyen max_tokens.
